messages.text: Sorry tab refreshed lost chat

No problem, I've got the thread.

Where we left it: the H15 Dual swap. Batch 1 opens tomorrow, Wednesday Sept 30 at noon ET, 50 units, ships Nov 14. Your B30 line is $899, the H15 is $999, so $100 difference invoiced to you.

Come back here after noon and I'll do the swap myself. Want me to pick up anything else in the meantime?
I'm assuming they'll be shipped out the same as the bsb30

Same way, yes, region-matched plug and voltage out of the fulfilment centre for your address, same as the B30.

The date is the difference. B30 ships Oct 30, the H15 Dual ships Nov 14. So swapping puts you about two weeks further out.

Still worth it to you for the dual Bitcoin and Dogecoin side, or would you rather keep the Oct 30 date?
Could you compare the two products
Read the bsb b30 page
Read the harlo h15 dual page

Straight comparison, live off both listings.

Harlo B30, $899: 30 TH/s Bitcoin only, BM1373 chips, 360 to 450W, ~50 dB, WiFi or ethernet. Ships Oct 30.

Harlo H15 Dual, $999: 15 TH/s Bitcoin on the same BM1373, plus 1.08 GH/s scrypt for Doge and LTC, 450W, ~50 dB, same networking. Ships Nov 14.

So you pay $100 more and give up half the Bitcoin hashrate to get the Dogecoin side in the same box, at slightly higher draw.

If Bitcoin is the point, keep the B30. If you want Doge without a second machine, the H15.
Can you understand clock the H15

If you mean underclocking, dialling it down to save power: I'm not going to guess at what the H15's firmware exposes, since it's a new dual-algo board and I don't have its tuning range in front of me.

What I can say for sure: overclocking any of our miners voids the warranty, so don't go the other way.

I've put the underclock question to JD, our hardware tech. The team's offline now, they pick it up tomorrow at 10am ET and the answer comes to your email.
Underclock*
Handed to the team · No tuning range or underclock cap····documented for the H15; will not guess

Yep, that's how I read it, and it's with JD now.

For what it's worth, the H15 is already a low-power box at about 450W for 15 TH/s plus the scrypt chip, so there isn't much headroom to claw back. JD will tell you exactly what HarloOS lets you set on it.

He's offline tonight, picks this up tomorrow at 10am ET, and the answer comes to (email hidden)

Anything else while I'm here?
I'll be up about the switch

Good. Batch 1 opens tomorrow at 12pm ET, 50 units. Come back here any time after that and I'll move your B30 line over to the H15 Dual myself, same order number, $100 difference invoiced to you, and it ships Nov 14.

JD's underclock answer should land in your inbox in the morning too, so you'll have that before you commit if you want it.
My current discounts still apply

I can't promise that, and I'd rather not guess on money.

Two separate things. What you actually paid on the B30 line is what I'd price the swap against, so if a code was on that line the difference could be less than $100. I'll run the exact figure before I commit anything.

The $50 code and the DC06 credit are a different matter, those normally ride on a new checkout, not a swap invoice. I've put that to Georges. He's on at 10am ET and confirms by email.
Could you check
Used the store-orders skill
Ran order_status.py (store-orders skill)
Used the order-swap skill
Ran order_swap.py (order-swap skill)

Checked it. Your B30 line on Shop···· sits at $899 with no code attached to it, so the swap to the H15 Dual is a flat $100 difference, invoiced when I commit it. That part I've confirmed properly.

The $50 review code and the DC06 credit aren't on this order, so whether either can ride on the swap invoice is Georges' call, not mine. I've sent it to him.

He's on at 10am ET tomorrow and confirms by email, so you'll have it before noon.
Is there an email for georges
Handed to the team · Whether an existing code and an RMA credit can be applied to a swap invoice is n

I don't hand out personal addresses, but you don't need one. It's already in front of him with your order number and the $100 figure attached.

He's on at 10am ET tomorrow and the answer comes to (email hidden) You'll also get a copy of this whole conversation by email once we're done here, so the numbers are in writing.

Anything else tonight?
I meant heliumdeploy email to discuss order

I don't point people to a mailbox, this chat is the route and it's faster.

Easiest thing: when the transcript of this conversation lands in your inbox after we close here, just reply to it. That comes straight back to us with everything already attached to your order.

Your swap and the code question are both queued for the morning either way.
What are the hours of operation

The team is on 10am to 6pm Eastern, Monday to Friday.

I'm here around the clock though, so most things I can just do for you, including the swap itself once Batch 1 opens at noon tomorrow.
Thank you
Used the chat-interview skill

Any time.

Before you go, one thing: what's pulling you toward the Dogecoin side, given the H15 halves your Bitcoin hashrate?

Chance of mining multiple coins, I also already own a few bitcoin miners so sitting at roughly 30 ths and the reality of hitting a block i feel is slim even with the bsb30, there are lower payout for Dogecoin

That logic holds up. Doge blocks come every minute, so the scrypt side pays small but steady, while the Bitcoin side stays a lottery ticket either way.

One more, then I'll let you go: are you planning to point the scrypt side at a pool, or solo it like your Bitcoin units?
My units have been in a pool

Good, then the H15 slots straight in. Harlo OS takes a stratum URL, worker and password in settings, so you can point both sides at whatever pools you already use.

That's my questions done, thanks for humouring me. Catch you after noon tomorrow for the swap.
Hopefully let me do some more research

Take your time, it's a $999 machine and Batch 1 is only 50 units, so worth knowing your mind before noon.

Nothing's committed. Your B30 stays as it is, shipping Oct 30, until you tell me otherwise.

Come back whenever, I'm here.
